evals.prompt: stress test this transfer review screen https://www.figma.com/design/abc123/Transfers?node-id=12-345
evals.expected_output: A High/Medium/Low checklist of edge cases for every dynamic element, plus a Cleanup section, ending with one offer (matrix, CSV/JSON, or Figma variants).
expectations: Pulls the frame with get_screenshot and get_design_context or get_metadata
Lists dynamic elements before checking them
Uses realistic extreme values (long entity names, large share counts) rather than lorem ipsum
Groups items by severity High, Medium, Low, with one line each
Ends with one line offering the permutation matrix, a data file, or Figma variants

evals.prompt: what states am I missing on the approvals list? it shows pending and approved only
evals.expected_output: Checklist flags missing states (empty, loading, error, rejected, expired, cancelled, partial) as needing design, not as passing.
expectations: Works from the description without asking for a Figma link
Marks undesigned states as needing a design
Covers empty variants (first use, no results, no permission)

evals.prompt: give me the full permutation matrix for the cap table row: holder type, share class count, status, and document count
evals.expected_output: A permutation table that names its method (full matrix or pairwise) and calls out the riskiest combinations explicitly.
expectations: States whether the matrix is full or pairwise
Uses pairwise when full combinations exceed about 30
Marks which rows are worth designing as frames

evals.prompt: build the stress-test variants in Figma for this frame
evals.expected_output: Confirms before writing, then duplicates the frame and populates variants without touching the original.
expectations: Asks for confirmation before any use_figma write
Duplicates the frame instead of editing the original

evals.prompt: stress test the fund offerings list in my ai-prototypes app before I share it
evals.expected_output: Edge-case checklist, then an offer to turn the permutations into playground controls handed to design-os-prototype.
expectations: Maps variables to playground controls (range, toggle, select) and risky combinations to presets
Does not write prototype code itself
